Metadata.title: BrightSmile Dental — Calm, Gentle Dentistry in Moscow

Privacy.metaDescription: How BrightSmile Dental processes and protects personal data under Russian Federal Law No. 152-FZ.
Privacy.title: Personal Data Policy
Privacy.intro: This Policy is issued under Russian Federal Law No. 152-FZ “On Personal Data” of 27 July 2006. It explains, in plain language, what information we receive through our website, why we need it, and the choices you have.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: Your personal data is controlled by {legalName}{legalDetails}, {address}. For any privacy questions, email {email} or call {phone}.

sections.title: 2. What we collect
paragraphs: Only what you enter in the booking form: your name and phone number and, if you choose, a service, a dentist, a preferred date and time, and a comment.
We don't ask for health information through the website. Please don't include it in the comment field — your dentist will go over everything at your visit.

sections.title: 3. Why we use it
paragraphs: To call you back, schedule your visit and answer your questions. We don't use your details for marketing, and we never sell them.

sections.title: 4. Legal basis
paragraphs: Your consent to the processing of personal data (Art. 6(1)(1) of Law No. 152-FZ), which you give by ticking the consent box in the booking form.

sections.title: 5. How we process it
paragraphs: We collect, record, organize, store, update, use, transfer, block, delete and destroy data, both with and without automated tools.

sections.title: 6. Transfer and storage
paragraphs: Your request is delivered to our front desk team via Telegram, and the website is hosted on Vercel. These services may keep data on servers outside Russia, so by sending the form you agree to this cross-border transfer.
We don't share your data with anyone else unless Russian law requires it.

sections.title: 7. How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep your data only as long as needed for the purposes above, and no longer than 12 months after your request or until you withdraw consent, whichever comes first. After that it is deleted.

sections.title: 8. Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask how your data is processed, have it corrected, blocked or destroyed, and file a complaint with Roskomnadzor (the Russian data protection authority) or a court.
Send requests to {email}. We reply within 10 business days, or up to 5 more business days if we tell you why we need extra time.

sections.title: 9. Withdrawing consent
paragraphs: You can withdraw your consent at any time by emailing {email} with the subject “Withdraw consent”. We'll stop processing and destroy your data within 30 days.

sections.title: 10. Security
paragraphs: Only staff who handle scheduling can see booking requests. We take the legal, organizational and technical measures required to protect your data from unauthorized access.

sections.title: 11. Cookies and analytics
paragraphs: We don't use advertising cookies or web analytics. The Contact section includes an embedded Google Map; when it loads, Google may set its own cookies under its own policy.

sections.title: 12. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this Policy. The current version is always posted on this page with its effective date.

About.title: A clinic where we talk first
About.story1: Anna Sokolova opened the clinic in 2014, after ten years in chain clinics where dentists were expected to sell as much treatment as possible. We decided to work the other way round: an exam and a conversation first, then a written plan with prices, and treatment only once you agree.
About.story2: Today there are four dentists and three treatment rooms. Appointments don't overlap, so if you're booked for 10:00, you're in the chair at 10:00, not waiting in the hallway.
About.quote: If someone is scared, we don't start. We get to know each other, show them the instruments and agree on a stop signal. Sometimes nothing gets treated on the first visit, and that's fine.

numbing.title: Numbing that works
numbing.text: We apply a numbing gel before every injection and choose the anesthetic with your health and allergies in mind. Raise your hand and we stop.

plan.title: A written plan with prices
plan.text: After the exam you take home a printed plan. The price won't go up because of something we missed.

warranty.title: Up to {years}-year warranty
warranty.text: On implants, crowns and veneers, and two years on fillings. The terms are in your contract, not just a verbal promise.

scan.title: Scans on site
scan.text: The 3D scanner is in the next room, so there's no trip to a separate imaging center and back.

kids.title: Kids from age three
kids.text: Dr. Granina sees children. The first visit is about getting comfortable with the chair and the tools; treatment starts next time.

everyday.title: Open seven days
everyday.text: Until 8 pm Monday to Saturday and 4 pm on Sunday, so you can come by after work.
